scenes.title: The wagon by the road
scenes.caption: East of the Caspian Gates, the Macedonian riders came upon a wagon left behind on the road. Darius lay inside. In Arrian's account he had died of his wounds by the time Alexander reached him.
scenes.prompt: Near Hecatompylos, July 330 BCE. Alexander has just dismounted and stands quietly at a respectful distance with two attendants; tired horses and pursuit dust behind. scenes.title: Letters for Ecbatana
scenes.caption: After Philotas was executed at Phrada, a courier rode west with letters for officers serving under his father, Parmenion. They received the order to kill Parmenion before he had heard what had happened to his son.

scenes.title: Under the shields
scenes.caption: Inside the Malli town, Alexander's companions held their shields over him after an arrow struck him in the chest. Beyond the wall few men could see what had happened, and word spread that he was dead.

scenes.title: The door of Cyrus's tomb
scenes.caption: Above the stone steps at Pasargadae, a small doorway led into Cyrus's burial chamber. Robbers had stripped it. Alexander entrusted the repairs to Aristobulus, who had the entrance walled up and set a seal on it.
